summary: Describes how Ethernet VLANs, commonly used to separate traffic in enterprise networks, can be used to deploy IPv6 early, before switch-routers support it. It addresses coexistence of IPv4 and IPv6 in the same enterprise. This is informational guidance.

eli5.summary: A company wants to try a new kind of address without breaking the old one. This shows how to keep them in separate lanes of the same network so both work.
